messages:
maya: Hey team — AcmeHealth POC: SAML SSO is working but SCIM provisioning keeps failing. They can't provision users into the Private VPC environment. Can we triage?

ajay: Can you paste the SCIM error from Okta? Also confirm whether we gave them a SCIM bearer token from Console or if they wired Basic auth.

maya: Pasting curl we ran from Okta integration test (sanitized):

```
curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_TOKEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/scim+json\" \
  https://scim.private.redwood.example/customers/acme/v2/Users
```

Response: 403 Forbidden
{\"error\":\"forbidden\",\"detail\":\"IP not allowed or invalid token\"}

maya: They say they updated token in the Okta app and still 403.

danny: 403 can be token invalid OR IP allowlist on the Private VPC/ALB blocking Okta's outbound IPs. Which env is this exactly? Dedicated pool or Private (VPC)?

maya: Private VPC in us-east-1. Customer told us their firewall is locked down to corp IPs.

claire: Also check attribute mapping in SAML/SCIM: Okta often posts userName/email vs externalId. Our SCIM integration expects userName (email) present and externalId is used to map to their internal user. If attributes misaligned, provisioning can fail downstream.

ajay: For the POC we normally create a short-lived SCIM bearer token from the Console that scopes to /scim/* and push that into the Okta app. Make sure they didn't swap in a regular API key. Authorization header should be exactly:

```
Authorization: Bearer <scim-token>
Content-Type: application/scim+json
```

maya: I regenerated a SCIM token in the Console and updated the Okta app. Still 403. Here's the verbose output from the Okta test request (sanitized):

```
> POST /v2/Users HTTP/1.1
> Host: scim.private.redwood.example
> Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
< HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
< Content-Type: application/json
{
  \"error\": \"forbidden\",
  \"detail\": \"Request source IP 34.201.12.98 not in allowlist\"
}
```

danny: Bingo — IP allowlist on the Private endpoint. Okta's provisioning calls originate from a set of vendor IP ranges. Two options for POC:
  1) Customer updates firewall to whitelist Okta provisioning IP ranges (we can send the list).
  2) We enable our SCIM relay/proxy (hosted plane) that Okta talks to; relay then forwards to their Private instance over an authenticated tunnel we manage. For short POCs we often spin up the relay for 48–72h to avoid changing customer firewall rules.

olga_acme: We can't open firewall rules without a security change request that takes 2 weeks. Relay would be much better.

claire: Relay is fine for POC, but needs audit trail and short-lived credentials. I can prepare a security attestation: enable relay for 48h, use short-lived token, log all provisioning calls to our audit logs, and rotate token after the window. I'll need SOC/infra signoff but that's straightforward.

ajay: Also a reminder to validate SAML attribute mapping before running full sync — Okta's default mappings sometimes omit externalId which our dedupe relies on. Send me their IdP metadata and SCIM app config screenshot and I’ll validate mappings.

maya: Plan & action items:
- ajay: validate IdP metadata + SCIM attribute mappings (owner: ajay)
- danny: enable SCIM relay for 48h and return relay endpoint + temp token (owner: danny)
- claire: prepare short security attestation & logging config (owner: claire)
- maya: coordinate with Acme to confirm relay acceptance and kick off provisioning tests (owner: maya)

ETA: aiming to enable relay and complete a first sync by EOD tomorrow.

ajay: One more gotcha — Okta can optionally send user provisioning as PUT vs POST; make sure our proxy accepts both and preserves the 'If-Match' header behavior. I'll add a quick test script.

danny: Will enable proxy and add IP-level acceptance for relay traffic only. I'll post the temporary relay URL here when ready.

olga_acme: Great, thanks everyone. Relay preferred.

claire: I'll include the audit sample (log snippet) in my attestation:
```
2024-06-12T15:32:10Z acme-scim POST /v2/Users status=201 principal=okta-app-123 token_id=tmp-rt-456
```

maya: Thanks team — looping in customer success to scope next steps. I'll update this thread when relay is live. :thumbsup:
